newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end down led by blue-chips.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end down led by blue-chips.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged down in trading that brokers said was influenced by drops in two of the country's leading shares.
Bogota's IBB price index dropped 0.16 percent to 1,199.56 on volume of 4.0 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index fell 0.08 percent to 18,281.26 on volume of about 2.0 billion pesos.
Traders said the markets were influenced by drops in two of the country's leading shares, blue-chip Banco Ganadero and giant brewer Bavaria.
Shares of Banco Ganadero common stock fell 1.23 percent to 400 pesos on 482 million traded in Bogota, and ended down 0.74 percent at 400 on volume of 51 million in Medellin.
Brokers said the dip was the result of heavy profit taking in Ganadero on Wall Street.
Bavaria fell 0.38 percent to 8,000 on volume of 119 million in Bogota, and by 0.24 percent to 8,000 in Medellin.
Banco de Bogota, Colombia's third largest bank in terms of assets, rose 0.42 percent to 6,829 in Bogota, and was up 0.73 percent to 6,850 in Medellin.
